identity.headline: Aidan Calderhead | Data Detective · Agency Advocate · Solutions Strategist
identity.bio:
Welcome to my local environment.

This space is an extension of my passion for the underlying logic of our world. I believe that data, when grounded in the frameworks of mathematics and systems theory, is more than just a static resource: it is a catalyst for self-empowerment. In my practice, investigation and action operate in harmony rather than sequence: detective-like inquiry maps complex variables, a strategic vision engineers the path for data-driven growth, and an advocacy for agency ensures every logical step serves a human purpose.

No two systems are identical, and I don't believe in one-size-fits-all outputs. My approach is rooted in an attentiveness to detail and a drive to engineer unique solutions fit precisely to any project I get my hands on. By aligning intentional mathematical analysis directly with the human pulse behind the numbers, I ensure final results are not only functionally robust, but also purposefully built for the people they serve.

I invite you to explore the tools, models, and projects within this space to see how this philosophy translates into practice.

Find patterns. Empower choice. Engineer a way forward.

caseFiles._note: Three tabs: major, minor, hypotheses. repoUrl null hides the GitHub link. status: live | archived | wip | null. desc is hidden in the minor tab — controlled by app.js, not here.

major.title: NLP Pipeline Engine
major.desc: Full-stack extraction tool parsing YouTube metadata and generating thematic clusters via BERTopic. Reduced manual tagging overhead by 80% and enabled downstream topic analysis at scale.

major.title: LP Timetable Solver
major.desc: Binary Linear Programming model solving NP-hard course scheduling. Reduced faculty conflicts by 40% while satisfying all hard constraints across 200+ course sections.

minor.title: ETL Automation Scripts
minor.desc: Collection of reusable ETL scripts for flattening nested JSON payloads and loading structured records into SQL databases.

minor.title: Tableau Dashboard Templates
minor.desc: A library of Tableau workbook templates with parameterised data sources and standardised colour systems for rapid deployment.

hypotheses.title: Generative Audio Synth
hypotheses.desc: Exploring generative models for real-time procedural audio and adaptive music systems driven by live data streams.

hypotheses.title: UI Prompt Engineering
hypotheses.desc: Systematic prompt design patterns for predictable, controllable LLM-driven interface behaviours across interaction contexts.

hypotheses.title: Wholesome Data Scraping
hypotheses.desc: Ethical pipelines for public dataset collection — built-in anonymisation, provenance tracking, and consent frameworks.
